visual_action: A man, Harry Styles, is on a dark stage playing a guitar. The camera zooms in on a sticker on his guitar that says "BETO FOR TEXAS". The video then cuts to a shot of a man in a baseball cap, Beto O'Rourke, in the audience, and then to a wider shot of the cheering crowd. The video ends with two black title cards with white text.

cast.name: Beto O'Rourke
cast.evidence: A sticker on a guitar reads 'BETO FOR TEXAS', he is briefly shown in the crowd, and a final title card reads 'Beto O'Rourke for Texas Governor'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the @democrats TikTok account.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat pop song 'As It Was' by Harry Styles, which plays throughout.
editing_pacing: The video uses a few quick cuts and a zoom-in to connect the performer, the political endorsement, the candidate, and the crowd.
central_claim: Musician Harry Styles supports Beto O'Rourke for Texas Governor.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and popular support for Beto O'Rourke's campaign by highlighting a major celebrity endorsement.
